# uptimecheck_project (Resource)

A project groups monitors and status pages, for example per client. Deleting it leaves its monitors and status pages without a project; its client reports and client access are deleted with it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimecheck_project" "acme" {
  name  = "Acme"
  color = "#22D37A"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique in the workspace, at most 60 characters.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Hex color of its label, e.g. #1F5CFF (the default).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project's id (prj_…).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A project is imported by its id.
terraform import uptimecheck_project.acme prj_...
```
